description: Search DiscoverIA's registry of AI-assisted scientific claims by free text, status, lab, discipline and announcement date. Returns paginated entries with their current status, the date that status was observed and a link to the entry's page. A status says where the evaluation of a claim stands, not whether the result is true. Entries from the frozen Erdős-wiki archive have statuses dated at the freeze.

announced_from.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps entries whose announcement period ends on or after this date (a claim dated '2026-02' matches announced_from '2026-02-15').

announced_to.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps entries whose announcement period starts on or before this date.

include_archive.description: Include the frozen archive of T. Tao's AI-Erdős wiki (about 520 entries). Default true.

lab.description: Lab slug from DiscoverIA's lab report, e.g. 'openai', 'google-deepmind', 'anthropic', 'harmonic', 'math-inc'. Matches claims announced by the lab and results obtained by others with its systems. The Erdős-wiki archive is not attributed to labs.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

query.description: Free text matched against title, claimant, id, discipline and nature. All words must match; accents and case are ignored. Omit to list everything.

status.description: Keep only entries with this status (see list_statuses).

name: search_announcements
title: Search the DiscoverIA registry
